name: @sprite-foundry/townsfolk-48
description: Townsfolk — Pack 06 | 16 medieval NPC archetypes × 8 directions × 3 layers | 48px pixel-art sprite pack
author: mcp-tool-shop

scripts.verify: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=require('./pack.json');let ok=true;let total=0;for(const v of p.variants){const base=v.path.replace('manifest.json','');const m=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(v.path,'utf8'));const dirs=m.render_contract.direction_order;const layers=p.layers;for(const d of dirs){for(const l of layers){const f=base+l+'/'+d+'.png';if(!fs.existsSync(f)){console.error('MISSING:',f);ok=false}else{total++}}}}if(ok){console.log('All assets verified: '+total+' files across '+p.variants.length+' variants')}else{process.exit(1)}"
